description: American Roadstar R/T Tires The American Roadstar R/T is a rugged terrain, all weather tire created for light trucks and SUVs. The model is designed to promote exceptional year-round performance. The ideal tread ratio enables good dry traction, while the sipes and the other biting edges strengthen the winter-weather grip. The compound blend enables the tire to operate in cold and warm weather by keeping the rubber pliable. On-road hydroplaning is also resisted, as wide grooves channel water and slush from underneath the tire to maximize its gripping power. The aggressive tire design easily conquers different terrains. Staggered blocks, with many biting edges, closely grip hard and uneven surfaces. The scalloped shoulders and the aggressive sidewall design provide better forward motion on softer and looser surfaces, preventing the model from getting stuck. The wide grooves and the mud ejectors keep the tread area clean of snow, mud, and rocks. This cleaning nature of the tire boosts its off-road performance. The tire’s ideal tread and close contact enhance its controllability and maneuvering. The optimal tread ratio and the sipes increase braking and cornering abilities. The ideal tire design and its consistent surface contact also promote superb driving stability and steering. This means the tire is quick and precise when responding to the driver’s orders, while the structure is protected under driving pressure. The model sports a stronger carcass. The carcass is enhanced internally to be stronger. As such, the tire can handle the demanding off-road performance with ease. The sturdy design prevents the model from deforming in such challenging conditions, preserving its optimal tire shape all the time. This works with the tread pattern to evenly spread out driving pressure along the footprint and avert pressure accumulation. These elements increase driving safety levels. The American Roadstar R/T prolongs its usage. The central tread blocks are connected with the multi-stepped tie bar. This and their bigger size keep them stable throughout the performance, which results in even wear. Close connection with the driving surface also helps. Moreover, the self-cleaning nature of the tire averts stone retention, increasing its service life greatly. All weather tires receive the three mountain peak and snowflake (3PMS) symbol for their exceptional winter weather performance. They are all season tires with extra winter weather grip, in order to guarantee safer year-round durability. This ensures their true and secure driving ability throughout the year. Not all tire sizes are suitable for all vehicle types. Please refer to the item specifications for accurate information about vehicle type fitment for this particular size. Manufacturers recommend changing tires every 10 years. As long as tires are properly stored before they are sold, the year of their manufacture will not shorten their service life.   Features and Benefits: All weather performance Rugged terrain grip Self-cleaning footprint Upgraded handling Enhanced durability Prolonged tread life

description: The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks. The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

name: WINDFORCE 265/65R17 112T RWL CATCHFORS A/T II
description: The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks. The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the detailed siping and groove placement work together to improve the grip on the road and terrain surface. This stronger traction guarantees the tire?s exceptional traction on-road and on soft, loose and uneven terrain surface conditions. This ensures the tire?s safer off-road performance, as it increases the surface contact throughout the drive. In this manner, the tire does not get stuck in deep mud or on soft dirt. The tread?s optimal elements also improve the self-cleaning capability. The tread eliminates mud and snow from the footprint, preventing them from blocking the tire?s surface contact. This further boosts the various terrain driving safety. The tread design improves the surface contact throughout the drive. The tread pattern improves the model?s grip and forward motion. The better road and surface contact enable the model to increase the steering responsiveness and the driving stability. As a result, the tire promotes great controllability on various off-road terrain surface conditions, ensuring the driver?s constant control over the vehicle. The optimal footprint also allows the tire to enhance the braking power. The tread elements successfully shorten the braking distance, improving the overall controllability of the tire. The model was designed with a reinforced internal structure. The construction features a jointless nylon band structure which helps maintain the optimal tire shape under the load and driving pressure, while also protecting the tire from external damage. The optimal tire shape under the heavy load pressure increases the tire?s load durability and load capacity. It also further stabilizes the structure during the tire?s performance. The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing. The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

name: PIRELLI 245/40ZR19 PZERO R D
description: Developed to provide even greater performance – on the occasion of Track Days – when fitted to the most powerful vehicles such as Porsche, Ferrari, BMW, Lamborghini, including the MY2012. With P Zero Trofeo R you can fully appreciate the performance of extreme vehicles in complete safety, especially on the track. In extreme conditions, typical of racetrack driving, it reacts with precision to commands. On dry asphalt, even in the most demanding sessions it ensures high levels of grip and constant trajectories. P Zero Trofeo R is not recommended for use in very wet track conditions. Specific for racetrack driving, it is approved for road use, enabling travel to the track. In the event of very wet asphalt, with the risk of aquaplaning, prudent driving at reduced speed is recommended. P Zero Trofeo R has brand new HAOF (highly aromatic oil free) compounds and a redesigned tread pattern that have produced extraordinary results: on the one hand, a notable improvement in stability and, above all lateral grip in the dry, on the other hand, a reduction in wear of up to 80%.

name: WINDFORCE 265/60R18 119/116S OWL WINDFO CATCHFORS A/T II
description: The Windforce Catchfors A/T is an all terrain, all season tire manufactured for SUVs and light trucks. The tire promotes a stronger all terrain performance. The staggered tread blocks and the detailed siping and groove placement work together to improve the grip on the road and terrain surface. This stronger traction guarantees the tire?s exceptional traction on-road and on soft, loose and uneven terrain surface conditions. This ensures the tire?s safer off-road performance, as it increases the surface contact throughout the drive. In this manner, the tire does not get stuck in deep mud or on soft dirt. The tread?s optimal elements also improve the self-cleaning capability. The tread eliminates mud and snow from the footprint, preventing them from blocking the tire?s surface contact. This further boosts the various terrain driving safety. The tread design improves the surface contact throughout the drive. The tread pattern improves the model?s grip and forward motion. The better road and surface contact enable the model to increase the steering responsiveness and the driving stability. As a result, the tire promotes great controllability on various off-road terrain surface conditions, ensuring the driver?s constant control over the vehicle. The optimal footprint also allows the tire to enhance the braking power. The tread elements successfully shorten the braking distance, improving the overall controllability of the tire. The model was designed with a reinforced internal structure. The construction features a jointless nylon band structure which helps maintain the optimal tire shape under the load and driving pressure, while also protecting the tire from external damage. The optimal tire shape under the heavy load pressure increases the tire?s load durability and load capacity. It also further stabilizes the structure during the tire?s performance. The stronger compound and the ideal construction work together to protect the tire from punctures, cuts and impact damage. The tread design?s self-cleaning pattern, on the other hand, avoids stone retention. The tread ejects rocks stuck between the tread elements, preventing them from drilling into the tread and damaging the casing. The Catchfors A/T provides a longer lasting usability. The stronger compound and the optimal tread design do not only offer great all weather traction and hydroplaning resistance, they also work to increase the tread life. The compound?s wear-resistant rubber elements and its prevention of heat build-up decreases the tread wear rate, while the tread design ensures even pressure distribution along the tread area. This combination significantly lengthens the tread life by ensuring a slow and even wear rate and manner.

name: GENERAL 225/65R17 102H FR GRABBER GT
description: A decent Mud Terrain tyre for the price. That about sums it up for the General Grabber. The General Grabber MT is General Tyre's solution to the offroad market for what they call "extremely difficult terrain". While we don't consider the General Grabber to be an "extreme" mud terrain tire when compared to the Mud Terrain tyres on the market, it does hold it's own in off-road applications. The General Grabber MT is very similar to the average MT tyre on the market in looks and performance. In the mud, it does decent while the tread is above it's half life. It's not the best in mud but a little better than average. The lack of sipes in the tread design does reduce it's potential traction somewhat on the road especially in wet weather driving although a lack of sipes is common in average MT tyres. The tyre does flex very well when aired down into the teens making it a good rock performer though the tyre does lack sidewall protection but the 3 ply construction offers moderate protection from rocks and trail obstacles. The tyre also does well in sand and snow. Overall when you look at the price and what you get for it, the General Grabber MT is a decent Mud Terrain tyre for the price.
